title: New product: what it's for
summary: Step 2 of 3 of the New product wizard for Diceroll (named in step 1, no repository): the six features as choices, each with one line on what it's for, the requirement rule live (Cloud Sync locked until Sign-in is chosen, Commerce allowed because Licensing is), planned platforms as chips, and the Free tier switch, beside a running summary of what Create will make and the card Home will show.
compare: The wizard is page-hosted in the console (Platform context, Home active, crumbs Home › New product) on ST-39's kit: a stepper with Repository or name (done, 'Diceroll, no repository'), What it's for (current), Create.
Nothing is created until Create, said once, in the summary card. There are no license defaults, compatibility window, accent picker or hero facts anywhere in the flow.

Six feature choices in canonical order, three across on desktop, tablet and wide, one column on phone (kit .choices.multi.cols-3): Licensing, Managed config, Ship builds, Sign-in, Cloud Sync, Commerce. Each has its service glyph and one short line on what it's for ('Gate Diceroll on a license.'); no foot: what Create sets up is listed once, in the summary.

Licensing and Ship builds start chosen. A chosen card has the accent tint and one rounded-square check (the group is a multi-select, role=checkbox, so no radio rings); the service colour stays on the glyph tile only, and the Free tier switch is the console accent like every switch.

Cloud Sync is locked (kit .choice.locked: dashed, a lock where the check would be, aria-disabled) while Sign-in isn't chosen, and its requirements carry their own marks: 'Needs ✓ Managed config 🔒 Sign-in' (kit .reqs), each with an accessible name ('Managed config, chosen', 'Sign-in, not chosen'). Choosing Sign-in unlocks it without choosing it.
Commerce shows 'Needs ✓ Licensing'; unchoosing Licensing also unchooses Commerce and says so on the card.
Planned platforms are chips (iOS, Android, Windows, Linux on; macOS and Web off) under the question alone. Channels, storefronts and SDK code show only for these; published builds add their own.
'Start with a Free tier' is on by default and says the tier's defaults in one line: 'Lifetime, 2 devices.' It disappears if Licensing is unchosen.

The summary (kit .mk-with-rail: 320 beside the wizard, 400 at wide; below 1280 under it, its two cards side by side) lists what Create makes in one change (a signing key, 4 features, the Default profile, catalog v1 and the Free tier, one per line; the collapsed bar adds 4 platforms), says Integration opens next, and previews the Home card with one glyph per chosen feature: exactly four here (Licensing, Managed config, Ship builds, Commerce), each with a tooltip and an accessible name, never one per service.
From a repository instead of a name, the features and platforms arrive filled from .pkey/ and the step says so; the layout is the same.
Foot: Back on the left, Continue as the one primary, and no note.

Phone: Cancel (✕ plus label) sits on the heading line at the right (kit .phone-inline), only the current step's label shows in the stepper, the choices stack one per row, the Free tier switch is 44×24, the summary moves below the wizard, and the Home preview shows four pips beside the name.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

designReview.reviewer: UX designer (visual critique of rendered screenshots)
designReview.verdict: Fixed: the Home preview shows exactly the four chosen features, the Free tier switch is the console colour, and the locked card no longer reads as clickable.

findings.issue: The On Home preview showed 6 icons for the 4 chosen features, because Ship builds expanded to three services.
findings.resolution: The preview card and its phone pips show one glyph per chosen feature (Licensing, Managed config, Ship builds, Commerce), each with a tooltip and an aria-label; the same rule as products.home.

findings.issue: The 'Start with a Free tier' switch took the Licensing accent (lime, olive in light) and was 36×20 on phone.
findings.resolution: data-service moved from the row to the icon tile, so the switch is the console accent. On phone the switch is 44×24.

findings.issue: The locked Cloud Sync card kept the same empty round selector as unchosen cards; all six cards used radio-like round selectors for a multi-select; 'first.' was orphaned.
findings.resolution: The locked card shows a lock where the check would be (it stays aria-disabled). Every card's selector is a rounded square. The line reads 'Needs Sign-in: choose it first' and requirement lines may run under the check, so it fits on one line on desktop and phone.

findings.issue: Phone: Cancel sat alone on its own line under the subtitle, indented by its ghost padding.
findings.resolution: On phone Cancel (✕ plus label) moves onto the heading line at the right, with the ghost padding pulled to the page edge.

findings.issue: The rail repeated the left side and narrated state; a tile in a card in a card was three borders for one tile.
findings.resolution: One 'Creates' card: heading, four lines (signing key, 4 features, default profile and catalog v1, Free tier) and the Home tile with no wrapper card. 'Nothing exists until Create…', 'Then Diceroll's Integration page opens.' and '4 planned platforms' are deleted. It is sticky (top = topbar + 16, 360 wide). The 'Opens Integration' caption belongs on the Create button of step 3, which this mockup does not draw, so it is not placed here.

findings.issue: The summary sat after Continue on tablet and phone; the phone stepper lost two of three labels.
findings.resolution: Below 1280 the summary is one expandable bar above the footer ('4 features · 4 platforms · Free tier'). On phone the stepper is 'Step 2 of 3: What it's for' plus a 3-segment progress bar, with 2px connectors. 'align-items: stretch' was not applied: with one rail card it would stretch a short card over the wizard's full height and recreate the void the sticky rail removes.

findings.issue: Ragged footer rules, a near-unreadable locked card, duplicated 'change later' promises.
findings.resolution: Footers are artifact names with no label and a 2-line minimum height so rules align across a row. The locked Cloud Sync card dims only its lock, keeps 4.5:1 text and says 'Select Sign-in to unlock'. 'Change these any time in Settings' is said once, under the heading; the Free tier helper is 'Lifetime, 2 devices.'; the platform helper is 'Channels, storefronts and SDK code follow these.'; Back lines up with the 24px gutter; the wizard caps at 1040px at 1920. The Needs line is 12px apart and stays on one line where the card is wide enough (1920); in a 224px card it wraps. Unselected chips already have a 1px neutral border.

findings.issue: Remove 'Turns on' footers or descriptions, or all footers.
findings.resolution: declined: The footers say which artifacts will exist, which is plan content; cut to names only instead of deleted.

findings.issue: Drop the On Home preview or turn it into a thumbnail.
findings.resolution: declined: The Home tile stays as one plain tile in the Creates card so the person sees what Create makes.

findings.issue: Draw saving, failed and other states.
findings.resolution: declined: New frames are a separate scope.
